items.title: OCC approves Trump family crypto company for trust charter
items.summary: The US financial regulator gave conditional approval for World Liberty Financial’s charter bid as ten Democrats signed onto a bill to “prevent corruption in banking applications.“

items.title: Prediction Markets Give the Fed 74% Odds of Standing Pat in September
items.summary: Traders across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Myriad are leaning the same way: no change at the September meeting.

items.title: Deel Takes Its DLUSD Stablecoin Wallet to More Than 80 Countries
items.summary: The payroll platform's dollar balance, issued through Stripe's Bridge and settled on Tempo, is now live across Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

items.title: Neynar Seeks a New Owner for Farcaster Seven Months After Buying It
items.summary: Protocol fees fell from $35.43 million in the first quarter to $376,740 so far in the third, according to DefiLlama.
